verdict.rationale: Eqvista's cap table page says it supports Rule 701 compliance and Form 3921 filing, so two of the story's three filing elements appear as first-party capabilities. That support rests on a single marketing sentence, with no detail on automatic threshold tracking or on generating forms from cap table data. Missing for 10: 83(b) election support, documentation that Rule 701 thresholds are tracked automatically, documentation that Form 3921 is generated from the cap table, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
